Package com.nexuslink.security.cert

Class CertificateGenerator

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.security.cert.CertificateGenerator
public final class CertificateGenerator extends Object
Generates self-signed X.509 certificates (RSA or ECDSA) with a configurable validity window and Subject Alternative Names, using BouncyCastle. The result carries the certificate and its private key; toPem(java.lang.Object) renders either as PEM for export.

  • Method Details

    • generate

      public static CertificateGenerator.GeneratedCertificate generate(String commonName, String org, CertificateGenerator.KeyType keyType, Duration validity, List<String> sans) throws Exception
      Builds a self-signed certificate.
      Parameters:
      commonName - the subject/issuer CN (e.g. "localhost")
      org - organization (O), may be blank
      keyType - key algorithm + size
      validity - how long the certificate is valid from now
      sans - Subject Alternative Names — DNS names, or IP:1.2.3.4 for IPs
      Throws:
      Exception

    • generateCsr

      public static CertificateGenerator.CsrResult generateCsr(String commonName, String org, CertificateGenerator.KeyType keyType, List<String> sans) throws Exception
      Generates a fresh key pair and a PKCS#10 certificate-signing request (CSR) for it — what you send to a CA to be issued a certificate. SANs, when given, go into a requested-extensions attribute. Returns the CSR as PEM (-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE REQUEST-----) plus the keys.
      Throws:
      Exception

      public static String toPem(Object pemObject) throws Exception
